data.one_liner: A Flutter package that applies customizable blur effects to its child widgets.
data.what_it_does: BlurBox provides a collection of widgets and extension methods to easily apply blur effects to UI elements. It supports standard blurs, animations, themes, directional and radial blurs, pattern overlays, and scroll-aware adjustments.
use_when: You need to apply a frosted glass or blur background effect to UI components.
You want animated transitions between different blur intensities.
You need specialized blur effects like directional, radial, or pattern-based blurs.
avoid_when: You are building performance-critical applications with heavy lists and notice rendering bottlenecks despite applying recommended physics.
You require non-blur standard container layouts only.
strengths: Extensive variety of blur variants (Radial, Directional, Kaleidoscope, Organic, etc.).
Supports animated and theme-aware blur behaviors out of the box.
weaknesses: Blur effects can be computationally expensive and impact performance on lower-end devices or large scrollable lists.
Limited platform-specific or backend capabilities beyond rendering visual effects.
data.minimal_example:
BlurBox(
  blur: 5.0,
  color: Colors.white.withAlpha(30),
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
  padding: EdgeInsets.all(20),
  child: Text('This text has a blurred background!'),
)
